features.title: Reject unprotected audit snapshots before agent spend
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/security-audit-snapshot.md. Actual permission bits must be checked after export before metadata publication. Preserve source bytes, budget refusal, owned cleanup, all prior tests and source-only limits. No target code or provider execution.
acceptance: Pass six frozen independent cases, including actual Linux and Windows-mounted mode observations.
Init refuses a snapshot that fails inspection before metadata/stage publication; exact export tree is checked.
No mode inspection result is represented as arbitrary same-user containment or tool isolation.
